6. 7. 8. In view of the above fact that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free

proceedings, rather the same would create further acrimony between them. There is
no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question. 9. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 150/2017, registered at Police Station Swaroop Nagar, Delhi, for the
